verdict.rationale: Veo is a text/image-to-video generation model, so surfacing AI-generated insights and suggestions from a user's own data is a data-analytics capability outside its product category. The evidence covers only video and audio generation, prompt adherence, and multi-turn editing, and nothing shows Veo analysing user data to produce insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
